label: Welcome to HVAC
title: Your six-week training plan
items: Weeks 1–4: online HVAC instruction.
Weeks 5–6: supervised training at the facility.
Your enrollment date and your first training date may differ. Confirm your dates with staff.

label: Your account
title: Signing in and returning
items: Open app.elevateforhumanity.org/learner/dashboard.
Use your existing student account. Use password reset if needed.
On a phone, open the navigation menu to find dashboard sections.

label: My Dashboard
title: Your daily starting point
items: Review your enrollment, onboarding notice and next required action.
Check notifications and program messages.
Use My Courses to open assigned training. Report missing course access to staff.

label: Onboarding
title: The remaining steps
items: Open Onboarding and follow each incomplete step.
Complete your profile and review required agreements.
Document approval comes from staff. Report a pending label on an approved upload.

label: Documents and agreements
title: Your student records
items: Documents holds uploads and their review status.
Agreements contains required acknowledgments and signatures.
Keep your contact information current in Profile.

label: Training links
title: When access arrives
items: Staff will send access instructions when the provider links arrive.
Check email, spam and your dashboard.
Follow the official setup instructions. Tell staff about broken or missing links.

label: My Courses
title: Lessons and learning progress
items: Open your assigned HVAC course and follow the lesson order.
Complete the reading, videos and required knowledge checks.
Return to unfinished lessons and confirm that progress saves.

label: Assignments and quizzes
title: Submitting your work
items: Open Assignments for activities and required submissions.
Read each instruction and deadline before submitting.
Review quiz feedback and ask your instructor about corrections or retakes.

label: Attendance
title: Hands-on training clock only
items: Use Attendance only for supervised, hands-on HVAC training.
Clock in when your instructor starts practical training. Clock out for breaks and when training ends.
Do not clock in for online theory, videos, quizzes, or study at home.

label: Attendance review
title: Accurate hours
items: Record only supervised, hands-on training in the time clock.
A recorded session remains pending until staff verify it.
Report a missed clock-out promptly. Staff must review unusually long sessions.

label: At the facility
title: Your hands-on appointment
items: Use the hands-on clock during your confirmed facility training session.
Theory study does not use a manual clock.
Confirm arrival time, address, safety requirements and needed supplies with David.

label: Schedule
title: Dates and deadlines
items: Use Schedule or Calendar to review assigned activities.
Confirm your online start date and facility dates with staff.
Contact staff promptly if a class or appointment is missing.

label: Messages and Get Help
title: Getting support
items: Read program messages and respond when requested.
Use Get Help or Support for login, course access or dashboard issues.
Include the page name, error text and time of the problem. Never send your password.

label: Progress and certificates
title: Your learning record
items: Use Progress and Grades to review recorded work.
Certificates shows credentials after staff or the issuing provider award them.
Course enrollment alone does not mean a credential has been earned.

label: Other dashboard tools
title: Resources as you need them
items: Resources and Files hold available learning materials.
Resume Builder and career tools support employment preparation.
Payment information appears only when it applies to your account. Ask staff about a mismatch.

label: HVAC topics
title: What is ahead
items: HVAC fundamentals, heating systems and cooling principles.
Electrical basics, airflow and systematic troubleshooting.
EPA Section 608 preparation. Staff will confirm exam arrangements.

label: Safety
title: Supervised practical work
items: Wait for instructor authorization before working on equipment.
Follow task-specific safety and protective equipment instructions.
This orientation does not authorize electrical, gas or refrigerant work.

label: Your facility contact
title: David Nazaire
items: INDY ON DEMAND SERVICES LLC
Email: indyondemandservices@gmail.com
Call to introduce yourself and coordinate your facility dates.

label: Your first activity
title: A readiness checklist
items: Review your dashboard and note unfinished tasks.
Prepare your device, internet connection and notebook.
Write two questions for your instructor and choose a regular study time.

label: Before you leave
title: Your daily checklist
items: Clock out when hands-on training ends or you take a break. Theory study does not require clocking in.
Confirm saved work and check messages.
Tell staff about missing access or hours. Keep your next training date handy.
